I replied to Tobias in a thread under their message in #central-random. I confirmed the correction: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats. I also suggested they edit their #central-team post themselves, so people reading that channel see the right number.

Tobias asked for no action, so I didn't do anything else. A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, and Tobias posted it here themselves, so repeating it in the channel was fine.
